description: What a monthly budget buys in the managed SLSBMB AI Sending Engine — sending domains, inboxes, campaign emails a day and a month, new people a month, cost per email and per planned reply, and the month-by-month ramp — or the smallest budget that reaches a number of new people a month, with what agencies charge around that budget. Use it for questions like "how many cold emails does $3,000 a month buy?" or "what budget reaches 5,000 new people a month?".

monthly_budget_usd.description: Monthly budget in US dollars; the public ladder runs from 800 to 100000.

new_people_per_month.description: New people to reach each month; when given, the smallest budget that reaches them is returned.
